I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function. I need to provide the day, start time, and body of the email.
- The day is Thursday.
- The start time is 14:30.
- The body of the email should be a standard confirmation, informing the partners of the meeting details. I'll make sure it's clear and professional.

After sending the email, the task will be complete. I will then end my session.I've received the confirmation from Alison and will now send the confirmation email to the partners.
